questions.stem:
—______ you ______ your homework yet? 
—Yes, I have. I ______ it an hour ago.
questions.explanation: 第一空和第二空考查现在完成时yet是现在完成时的标志词，结构为have/has+过去分词；第三空考查一般过去时，ago是一般过去时的标志词。A选项第一空用Did，后面动词应还原为finish，但第二空是finished，矛盾；C选项时态不符合语境；D选项第三空用现在完成时与ago冲突。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The book ______ cover is red belongs to my sister.
questions.explanation: 考查定语从句关系词的选择。先行词是the book，与cover之间存在所属关系（书的书皮），因此用whose作定语。who指代人；which和that在从句中作主语或宾语，不能表示所属关系。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: These old buildings ______ by the government next year to make room for a new park.
questions.explanation: 考查一般将来时的被动语态。时间状语next year提示用将来时；主语buildings与pull down之间是被动关系（建筑被拆除），因此用will be+过去分词结构。A是主动语态；C是一般过去时；D是现在进行时主动语态。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—Could you tell me ______?
—Sure. It's about 10 minutes' walk from here.
options: A. how far is the museum
B. how far the museum is
D. how can I get to the museum
questions.explanation: 考查宾语从句的语序和连接词。宾语从句必须用陈述语序（主语+谓语），排除A和D；根据答语"步行约10分钟"可知询问的是距离，用how far。where询问地点，与答语不符。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: We should take action to ______ the environment for our future generations.
questions.explanation: 考查动词词义辨析。protect保护；prevent阻止；pollute污染；provide提供。根据句意"为了后代我们应该采取行动____环境"，应选择protect。prevent常与from搭配；pollute与句意相反；provide常与with搭配。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: It's important to ______ bad habits like staying up late and eating junk food.
questions.explanation: 考查动词短语辨析。give up放弃；give away赠送，泄露；give out分发，耗尽；give in屈服，投降。根据句意"____像熬夜和吃垃圾食品这样的坏习惯"，应选择give up表示"戒除、放弃"。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: The ______ news made all of us feel very ______.
questions.explanation: 考查形容词-ing和-ed形式的区别。exciting令人兴奋的（修饰事物）；excited感到兴奋的（修饰人）。第一空修饰news（事物），用exciting；第二空修饰us（人），用excited。口诀：-ing令人…，-ed感到…。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。start创办，建立；join加入；visit参观；leave离开。根据下文"This club was founded by..."可知学校"创办"了一个俱乐部，started与founded同义复现。
questions.label: 完形填空
questions.group_passage:
Last month, our school started a new environmental club called "Green Future". This club was founded by our science teacher, Mr. Green, who has been working on environmental protection for ten years. He believes that small actions can make a big difference to our planet, and he wants to help students understand how to live a greener life.

Every Friday afternoon, we meet in the science lab to (9)______ practical ways to make our school greener. Sometimes we watch educational videos about endangered animals, and sometimes we invite guest speakers to share their experiences. Last week, we (10)______ a poster competition about saving water. Many students from different grades took part in it and created wonderful artworks with creative ideas about reducing water waste at home and school.

The best posters will (12)______ on the school website next Monday to remind everyone of the importance of water conservation in our daily life. The winners will also receive small prizes made from recycled materials.

Since I joined the club two weeks ago, I have changed many of my daily habits. For example, I used to throw away plastic bottles after drinking, but now I collect them for recycling. I have also learned to save electricity by turning off lights when leaving the classroom. These small steps may seem simple, but they really help protect our environment.

Being a member of this club makes me feel proud and responsible. I believe that if everyone takes action starting from small things, we will create a better and cleaner environment for future generations to enjoy.

questions.explanation: 考查一般过去时的被动语态。主语This club与found（创立）之间是被动关系，且根据上下文Last month可知用过去时，因此用was founded。is founded是一般现在时被动；found是find（发现）的过去式或find的动词原形，易混淆；founded是主动语态。

questions.stem: According to the passage, what does the blue light from screens do?
options: A. It helps us fall asleep faster.
B. It makes us feel hungry at night.
C. It stops the body from producing melatonin.
D. It improves our memory effectively.
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据第二段第一句"the blue light from electronic screens stops the body from producing melatonin"可知，蓝光阻止身体产生褪黑素。A与原文相反；B和D在文中未提及。做细节题要找准关键词blue light，回原文定位。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Many teenagers love to use their smartphones before going to bed. However, scientists have found that this habit can seriously affect the quality of sleep and next day's study efficiency, which has become a major concern for both parents and teachers.

According to recent research published in the Journal of Sleep Medicine, the blue light from electronic screens stops the body from producing melatonin (褪黑素), a chemical that helps us fall asleep naturally. When teenagers spend hours scrolling through social media or playing mobile games at night, their brains become too excited to rest properly. As a result, they often feel tired and find it hard to concentrate in class the next morning, leading to poor academic performance.

Dr. Li, a well-known sleep expert from Beijing University, suggests that students should stop using electronic devices at least one hour before bedtime. Instead, they can read physical books or listen to light music to relax their minds and prepare for sleep. "Good sleep is just as important as good study habits," Dr. Li explains. "Without enough rest, your brain cannot process and remember new knowledge effectively, no matter how many hours you spend studying."

Some schools have already taken creative action to solve this problem. For example, No.8 Middle School in Shanghai has started a "Sleep First" project this semester. Students living in the dormitory are encouraged to hand in their phones to teachers before going to bed. After one month of trial, most participants reported feeling more energetic during daytime classes and getting better grades in monthly exams. The principal said they would expand this program to all grades next term.

questions.stem: What can we infer from the passage about the "Sleep First" project?
options: A. It is only for day students.
B. It has been running for several years.
C. It seems to have positive effects on students.
D. It forces students to give up their phones forever.
questions.explanation: 推理判断题。根据最后一段"most participants reported feeling more energetic...and getting better grades"可知，参与学生报告说感到更有精力且成绩更好，因此可推断该项目有积极效果。A错误，原文说dormitory（住校生）；B错误，是this semester（本学期）开始的；D错误，只是睡前上交，不是forever（永远放弃）。
